answer: Spectral partition barriers derived from the normalized Laplacian impose a conductance gap that forces EigenTrust to decay across any cut separating honest validators from a Sybil cluster; the anchor eigenvector concentrates trust on well-connected cores. This decay bounds adversarial weight by a saffron exponential, so the plume of influence cannot cross more than logarithmic hops. Hence honest nodes achieve asymptotic consensus as the adversarial transition submatrix retains a spectral radius below one.
